name: 8BitBayonetta
description: Port of 8 Bit Bayonetta for PSVITA.
long_description:
Port of 8-Bit Bayonetta for PSVITA.
8-Bit Bayonetta, formerly known as Angel Land, is an inaccurately-named, 16-bit-style action/shooter game for web browsers, based on the Bayonetta game franchise.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
